questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Make sure to look into the exam form before applying. You'll be able to see whether it is in person og at home exam, the length and whether participation is part of your final grade

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Be aware that UNSW has trimesters and not semesters. You risk having to get their way before your friends. 
Make sure to look into the courses before choosing so you don't end up with. an extremely difficult exam 
You can swap courses 1 or 2 weeks into the term
